// why: The STATE BLOCK of the signal-forms contract (req-api-signal-forms): the members every control of this library carries, so that a form bound to any of them writes the same state into all of them. The gate `tools/check-forms.mjs` holds every control to this list and holds the eight declarations to one shape.
// why-a-list: It cannot be derived from `@angular/forms`. Every member of `FormUiControl` is OPTIONAL — the only required one is `value` — so the dependency admits a control that declares none of them, and `implements FormValueControl` is not the proof it looks like. The list is therefore a decision of this library, and the gate's point 2 holds it to the contract so that a misspelt member cannot enter it: a name outside the contract is an input the `Field` directive never binds and nothing reports.
// why-not-more: `min`, `max` and `step` are contract members too and are NOT here: they belong to a value with an order, so the date field and the slider carry them and the checkbox has no business with them. The block is what EVERY control carries.
